name: Elder Arthur Maxson
oracle_text:
Creature tokens you control have training. (Whenever a creature token you control attacks with another creature with greater power, put a +1/+1 counter on that token.)
Blind Betrayal — Sacrifice another creature: Elder Arthur Maxson gains indestructible until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: Creature tokens you control have training. (Whenever a creature token you control attacks with another creature with greater power, put a +1/+1 counter on that token.)

needs.what: the Training keyword (702.149): a triggered ability 'Whenever this creature attacks with another creature with greater power, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature', grantable by a grant_keyword static so 'Creature tokens you control have training' is a static with affects {controller: you, types: [Creature], is_token: true}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: training is not in the keyword list, so grant_keyword cannot name it. The nearest spelling, a grant_ability static handing tokens a granted 'attacks' trigger, has no supported way to say 'with another attacking creature with greater power': selector and trigger-filter 'power' take a fixed number, not one relative to the triggering creature's power, and a cmp of extreme_value against power_of self is an unverified guess; it would also leave the tokens without the keyword itself, which cards that check for training read
